approach_summary: Build a coherent mythic ritual world from generated hero imagery and support coverage; animate internal materials and atmosphere first, use cinematic continuation only when real temporal action is needed, and escalate density with the song.

options.name: The Fire-Spirit Rite
options.story_approach: An ancient fire-spirit wakes under ritual percussion, gathers through earth/ash/bodies/architecture, crosses thresholds, reaches apotheosis, and resolves into calm power.
options.rendering_route: Hybrid mythic living paintings plus bounded cinematic passages; volcanic nocturnal palette; fire, smoke, ash, sacred geometry and ritual architecture.

storyboard.description: Invocation: embers and hidden force wake in near-black ritual space.
Manifestation and procession: one coherent spirit gains identity and crosses sacred spaces.
Apotheosis and release: environment fully activates, then settles into transformed calm.

options.name: Ancestral Procession
options.story_approach: Human ritual participants carry an ancestral presence through a night procession toward a sacred convergence.
options.rendering_route: Cinematic body/torch/procession coverage with restrained living-scene environmental inserts.

storyboard.description: Gathering figures and torchlight establish communal ritual.
Procession crosses desert/ruin thresholds as percussion intensifies.
Collective convergence ends in dawn-like release.

options.name: Elemental Temple
options.story_approach: No central character; a sacred environment itself wakes as percussion activates fire, stone, water, smoke and sky.
options.rendering_route: Living-scene dominant environmental film with monumental architecture and reactive elemental states.

storyboard.description: Dormant temple geometry pulses under embers.
Fire/water/smoke systems activate progressively through the groove.
The temple reaches full luminous state and cools into stillness.
